summary: Expanded the universe around employer-funded workforce training and benefit administration with a bias toward small/mid-cap or less obvious public assets. The most relevant underfollowed lane is not consumer course content; it is the administrative and compliance layer: tuition-benefit workflows, healthcare credentialing, mandatory training, enterprise LMS, skills intelligence, and measurable workforce outcomes. Candidate list intentionally avoids mega-cap AI/cloud anchors and emphasizes companies whose education exposure may be hidden inside child-care benefits, healthcare SaaS, corporate training, or online-learning labels.
